ADR-094 decision 1 is absolute: the ANONYMOUS branch must remain in a module graph that reaches no network call site. apps/demo/src/__tests__/replay-module-graph.test.ts is the guard and must stay green. Give the signed-in branch its own module, following replay-run-detail.tsx's precedent.
Navigate using the run_id FROM THE APPROVE RESPONSE, never a client-constructed id.
A failed fetch must surface honestly and never fall back to recommendationFixtures. fetchRecommendations already refuses to (#1320); do not reintroduce it in the component.
Do not manipulate process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_* in tests to control branching — CI has real values. Mock the seam, the way demo-landing.test.tsx does since #1905.
Do not use useSearchParams in a route that must prerender — it fails the build with missing-suspense-with-csr-bailout, and jsdom cannot see it. #1907 hit this.
Renaming any user-visible string cascades to the e2e specs AND to tests/unit/test_phase_2_6_demo_exit_gate.py, which greps spec source text for prose titles. Grep before renaming.
